text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Half-hourly import in MW (positive is import) of the 8 NGED primaries metered in MW, for the first full Monday-to- Sunday week of January and of July 2026. Each row has its own vertical axis. The noise from one half-hour to the next, not the level, sets the smallest battery that can be seen.'
